query: After encountering a series of unpleasant interactions that left me feeling both uncomfortable and unsafe, I ultimately made the decision to delete all my online dating profiles. These negative experiences not only affected my perception of online dating but also made me question the efficacy of these platforms in fostering genuine connections. It became increasingly clear to me that the digital landscape, once viewed as a potential avenue for finding companionship, could sometimes lead to situations that undermine both trust and safety. Instead of fulfilling promises of connection, these experiences instilled a sense of wariness and insecurity that I found increasingly difficult to shake off. Thus, I took what I felt was the only reasonable step to protect my emotional well-being and regain a sense of control over my dating life.

The pressure to excel and impress the instructor took away from the simple pleasure of being in the kitchen, experimenting with flavors and ingredients. It became clear that the experience was no longer fulfilling, and I decided it was best to step back from those classes altogether.
